question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the reset link sent to your inbox. The link expires in 24 hours.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, PayPal, and bank transfers for annual plans. All payments are processed securely via Stripe.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Cancel Subscription. Your access continues until the end of the current billing period. No partial refunds for mid-cycle cancellations.

question: Is there a free trial available?
answer: Yes, we offer a 14-day free trial with full access to all Pro features. No credit card required to start. You can upgrade anytime during or after the trial.

question: How do I contact support?
answer: Reach us via live chat (bottom-right icon), email at support@example.com, or call +1-800-555-0199 Mon-Fri 9AM-6PM EST. Enterprise clients have dedicated support.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a 30-day money-back guarantee on all plans. Contact support within 30 days of purchase for a full refund. No questions asked.

question: How do I upgrade my plan?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing > Change Plan. Select your desired plan and confirm. Changes take effect immediately with prorated billing for the remainder of the cycle.

question: Do you offer discounts for nonprofits?
answer: Yes, we offer 40% off for registered nonprofits. Apply at example.com/nonprofit with your 501(c)(3) or equivalent documentation. Approval takes 3-5 business days.

question: How do I enable two-factor authentication?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Choose between authenticator app (recommended) or SMS. Save your backup codes in a secure location.

question: What browsers are supported?
answer: We support the latest versions of Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge. Internet Explorer is not supported. For best performance, use Chrome or Firefox.

question: How do I export my data?
answer: Go to Settings > Data > Export. Choose format (CSV, JSON, or PDF), select data types, and click Export. Large exports are emailed as a download link.

question: Is my data encrypted?
answer: Yes, all data is encrypted at rest using AES-256 and in transit using TLS 1.3. We undergo annual SOC 2 Type II audits and are GDPR compliant.

question: How do I add users to my team?
answer: Go to Settings > Team > Invite. Enter email addresses and assign roles (Admin, Editor, Viewer). Invitees receive an email with a link to join your workspace.

question: What is your uptime guarantee?
answer: We guarantee 99.9% uptime on all paid plans (99.99% for Enterprise). Check real-time status at status.example.com. Credits are issued for SLA breaches.

question: How do I integrate with Slack?
answer: Go to Settings > Integrations > Slack > Connect. Authorize the app in your Slack workspace. Configure which notifications to receive and in which channels.

question: Can I use the API without a paid plan?
answer: The API is available on Pro plans and above. Free trial includes API access. Rate limits vary by plan: Pro (1000/hr), Business (5000/hr), Enterprise (unlimited).

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Go to Settings > Account > Delete Account. This action is permanent and removes all data after 30 days. Download your data export first. Contact support to proceed.

question: Do you support single sign-on (SSO)?
answer: SSO is available on Business and Enterprise plans. We support SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, and OpenID Connect with providers like Okta, Azure AD, and Google Workspace.

question: What are your storage limits?
answer: Free: 1GB, Starter: 10GB, Pro: 100GB, Business: 1TB, Enterprise: Unlimited. Storage includes files, attachments, and backups. Upgrade anytime for more space.

question: How do I set up email notifications?
answer: Go to Settings > Notifications > Email. Toggle notifications for each event type (mentions, updates, reports). Set digest frequency: instant, hourly, or daily.

question: Is there a mobile app?
answer: Yes, available for iOS (14+) and Android (10+). Download from the App Store or Google Play. The mobile app supports offline mode with automatic sync.

question: How do I create custom reports?
answer: Go to Reports > Create Custom Report. Select data sources, add filters, choose visualization types, and save. Schedule automated delivery to stakeholders.

question: What happens when my trial expires?
answer: After 14 days, your account switches to the Free plan with limited features. Your data is preserved for 90 days. Upgrade anytime to restore full access.

question: How do I change my email address?
answer: Go to Settings > Profile > Email. Enter your new email and confirm with your password. A verification link is sent to the new address. Old email remains active until verified.

question: Do you offer annual billing?
answer: Yes, annual billing saves 20% compared to monthly. Go to Settings > Billing > Switch to Annual. The discount applies immediately with prorated credit for the current month.

question: How do I use webhooks?
answer: Go to Settings > Integrations > Webhooks > Add Webhook. Enter your endpoint URL, select events to subscribe to, and set a secret for verification. Test with the Send Test button.

question: What is your data retention policy?
answer: Active accounts: data retained indefinitely. Cancelled accounts: 90 days. Deleted accounts: 30 days. Audit logs: 2 years. Backups: 90 days. GDPR deletion: within 30 days upon request.

question: How do I share a project externally?
answer: Click Share on any project > Generate Public Link. Set permissions (view only or comment). Optionally add password protection and expiry date. Revoke access anytime.

question: Can I import data from competitors?
answer: Yes, we support direct import from Asana, Trello, Monday.com, and Jira. Go to Settings > Import > select platform. Mapping tools help align fields automatically.

question: How do I set up automated workflows?
answer: Go to Automations > Create Workflow. Set a trigger (event, schedule, or condition), add actions (send email, update field, notify), and activate. Templates available for common workflows.

question: What are your API rate limits?
answer: Pro: 1,000 requests/hour, Business: 5,000/hour, Enterprise: custom. Rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-*) are included in responses. Implement exponential backoff for 429 errors.

question: How do I enable dark mode?
answer: Go to Settings > Appearance > Theme > Dark Mode. You can also set it to follow your system preferences. Dark mode is available on web, iOS, and Android.

question: Do you have a partner program?
answer: Yes, our partner program offers 20% recurring commissions, co-marketing opportunities, and dedicated support. Apply at example.com/partners. Review takes 5-7 business days.

question: How do I configure SAML SSO?
answer: Go to Settings > Security > SSO > SAML. Enter your IdP metadata URL, entity ID, and certificate. Map attributes for email, name, and role. Test before enforcing.

question: What keyboard shortcuts are available?
answer: Press Ctrl+/ (Cmd+/ on Mac) to see all shortcuts. Common: Ctrl+K (search), Ctrl+N (new item), Ctrl+S (save), Ctrl+Enter (submit). Full list at docs.example.com/shortcuts.

question: How do I manage billing for multiple workspaces?
answer: Go to Settings > Organization > Billing. Consolidated billing is available on Business+. All workspaces are billed to one account with detailed per-workspace breakdown.

question: Is there an on-premise deployment option?
answer: On-premise deployment is available for Enterprise customers. Requires minimum 100 users. Includes dedicated support, custom SLA, and quarterly updates. Contact sales for details.

question: How do I troubleshoot sync issues?
answer: Try: 1) Check internet connection, 2) Force sync (Ctrl+Shift+S), 3) Clear cache (Settings > Advanced > Clear Cache), 4) Log out and back in, 5) Contact support with sync logs.

question: What compliance certifications do you have?
answer: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA (Enterprise), CCPA, and PCI DSS Level 1. Certification reports available upon request under NDA at trust.example.com.

question: How do I create a custom domain?
answer: Go to Settings > Domain > Custom Domain. Enter your domain, add the CNAME record to your DNS, and verify. SSL is automatically provisioned. Available on Business+ plans.

question: What integrations are available?
answer: We integrate with 200+ tools including Slack, Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, GitHub, Zapier, Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, and more. Browse all at example.com/integrations.

question: How do I request a new feature?
answer: Click the feedback icon (bottom-left) or visit feedback.example.com. Describe your use case and vote on existing requests. Top-voted features are prioritized in our roadmap.

question: Can I customize notification sounds?
answer: Go to Settings > Notifications > Sounds. Choose from 12 built-in sounds or upload a custom MP3 (max 5 seconds). Different sounds can be set for different notification types.

question: How does version history work?
answer: Every save creates a version. View history via the clock icon on any item. Compare versions side-by-side, restore any version with one click. History retained for 365 days on Pro+.

question: What is your disaster recovery plan?
answer: Data is replicated across 3 availability zones in real-time. Full backups run every 6 hours. RPO: 1 hour, RTO: 4 hours. Annual DR tests documented at trust.example.com.

question: How do I bulk import users?
answer: Go to Settings > Team > Import. Download the CSV template, fill in user details (email, role, department), and upload. Preview and confirm before importing. Max 1000 users per import.

question: Do you offer training or onboarding assistance?
answer: Free onboarding webinars every Tuesday. Pro+ includes 1-hour onboarding call. Enterprise gets dedicated CSM and custom training. Self-serve resources at learn.example.com.

question: How do I configure role-based access control?
answer: Go to Settings > Roles > Manage. Create custom roles with granular permissions per module. Assign roles to users or groups. Changes take effect immediately. Available on Business+.

question: What happens if I exceed my storage limit?
answer: You'll receive warnings at 80% and 95%. At 100%, uploads are blocked but existing data remains accessible. Upgrade your plan or delete unused files to free space.

question: How do I set up a staging environment?
answer: Go to Settings > Environments > Create. Name it 'Staging', configure separate integrations and data. Use environment variables to switch between staging and production.

question: Can I schedule messages and notifications?
answer: Yes, when composing a message, click the clock icon to schedule delivery. Choose date, time, and timezone. Scheduled messages can be edited or cancelled before sending.

question: How do I connect to the GraphQL API?
answer: Endpoint: https://api.example.com/graphql. Authenticate with Bearer token in the Authorization header. Interactive explorer at api.example.com/graphql/playground. Full schema docs available.

question: What languages is the platform available in?
answer: Currently available in English, Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Japanese, and Chinese. Go to Settings > Language to switch. Community translations welcome at translate.example.com.

question: How do I report a bug?
answer: Click Help > Report Bug, or email bugs@example.com. Include: steps to reproduce, expected vs actual behavior, browser/OS info, and screenshots. Critical bugs are triaged within 4 hours.

question: Do you support SCIM provisioning?
answer: Yes, SCIM 2.0 is supported on Enterprise plans. Configure in Settings > Security > SCIM. Works with Okta, Azure AD, and OneLogin for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning.

question: How do I archive completed projects?
answer: Right-click any project > Archive, or use the Archive button in project settings. Archived projects are hidden from default views but searchable. Restore anytime from the Archive section.

question: What is your cookie policy?
answer: We use essential cookies for functionality and optional analytics cookies. Manage preferences in the cookie banner or Settings > Privacy > Cookie Preferences. Full policy at example.com/cookies.

question: How do I use templates?
answer: Go to Templates in the sidebar. Browse community templates or create your own. Apply a template when creating new items. Share templates with your team via the template library.

question: Can I embed content on my website?
answer: Yes, click Share > Embed on any public item. Copy the iframe code and paste into your website HTML. Customize width, height, and theme. Available on Pro+ plans.

question: How do I manage API keys?
answer: Go to Settings > API > API Keys. Create, rotate, or revoke keys. Set permissions per key (read-only, full access). Keys can be scoped to specific resources for security.
